Lich — Tomb Sage (CV 50)

A preserved undead scholar with ink-blackened bones, ancient robes and books maintained with obsessive care. Centuries of unfinished research have worn away concern for the living.

Attributes: Brawn +0; Fortitude +1; Agility +1; Guile +1; Knowledge +2; Reason +2

HP: 36 · Speed: 6 · Size: 1 (medium) · Armor DR: 2*

Evasion: 1 Bane · Threat: 1 Bane · Stability: 0

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: Physical (2), Life (2)\ Immunities: Bleeding; Poisoned; Asleep

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates one complete outcome. All attacks use the printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Details

Unwritten memory

For a moment, the victim remembers a pain that has not happened yet.

Target: One visible creature within 8 squares. Player defense: Reason. Damage type: mental.

Weak defense: Dazed 2. Standard defense: Dazed 1.

Spell: Provokes when cast beside an enemy.

Spell Screen

Before one spell against it resolves, impose 1 Bane on that player attack (or give its controller 1 defense Boon). For one player AoE roll, include this when choosing worst-case modifiers. Does not cancel the spell.

Reproach the Caster

A whispered accusation rides the fading spell back toward the one who shaped it.

After a spell attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, its visible caster within 6 squares gains Frightened 2 of this creature if the caster can hear it. This creature must survive and remain capable. No trigger from a free attack or another retaliatory effect. Frightened applies only while this creature is perceptible; the spell is not canceled.

Study the Opening

It waits for a tell in the stance, then turns its attention to the exposed line.

Its next attack before the end of this turn imposes 1 additional Bane on player defense, or gains 1 Boon when player-controlled. One attack only; no stacking with itself.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

Lifeless Body: does not breathe or eat; only the listed immunities apply.

Healing: Healing-harmed: ordinary healing resolves as Life damage instead; no beneficial riders.

Against offensive healing: controller defends with Fortitude if this is player-controlled; a player attacking it still rolls only their attack.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Signs: Fresh annotations appear in books sealed centuries ago.

Purpose: Finish one impossible piece of research, whatever the living must pay.

Tactics and retreat: Disrupt approaching heroes with Mind Hammer and protect itself with Spell Screen; bargain for a missing text.

Counterplay and conversation: Remove its research from the chamber or offer knowledge it cannot take by force.

Habitat: Sealed library; tomb · Communication: Common and ancient scholarly languages

Loot: Research, a named recipe chosen by the DA, and 150 coins; no automatic resurrection anchor.

Summoning: Ineligible.

Design notes — not needed during play

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.

CV worksheet

Difficulty rationale: An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

Reference damage: 4/6/8

Reference type: mental

Expected targets: 1

Utility factor: 1.65

Action review (#1279): U 1.5 → 1.65: Maneuver allowance +0.05, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

Regeneration per turn: 0

Reference I=2.404, O=6.596. CV uses the seed worksheet; action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.
